chars.MAN: a neat Moroccan man about 30, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a fitted white t-shirt and dark-green tracksuit trousers
chars.MAID: an older Moroccan woman in her late 50s, wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a burgundy headscarf tied at the back, small gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a dark quiet villa living room outside Casablanca, lit only by blue moonlight from a window. MAID is caught mid-movement tiptoeing across the room, glancing back over her shoulder with a guilty startled face, seen from the top of the stairs. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, centered. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a tidy upstairs bedroom in the dark. MAN sits bolt upright in bed, eyes wide, holding the blanket, listening to strange noises, scared. Centered, face visible. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, MAN peeks out of his half-open bedroom door into a long dark hallway; at the far end a vague moving shadow on the wall. Tense, curious expression, face visible in the foreground. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, MAN stands at a window looking out, puzzled; outside, an empty dark landscape with only a few small houses very far apart. Seen from inside, MAN in the center, face visible in profile. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Early morning, a perfectly tidy Moroccan living room. MAN in the center bends over a low wooden table and stares, frowning, at a single used tea glass left on it. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A clean Moroccan kitchen in the morning. MAN in the center sniffs the air with a wrinkled nose and suspicious face, hand near his nose, looking around. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Day, Moroccan kitchen. MAN stands with arms crossed, questioning MAID seriously; MAID holds a dish towel and looks away, avoiding his eyes, nervous. Both faces visible, both in the central area. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of MAID in a kitchen, shaking her head no with a forced smile, but her eyes are nervous and shifty, a drop of sweat on her temple. Face centered in the upper-middle of the frame. 2D cartoon illustration, vertical.
